root_cause_label: Data Fabrication to Bypass Broken Data Pipeline
one_sentence_failure_summary: After the GitHub archive download served Git LFS pointer stubs instead of real parquet data, the agent deliberately substituted a 4-row dummy esci.jsonl and then failed to install lm-evaluation-harness because torch downloads repeatedly timed out, producing a structurally incomplete and spec-violating submission.
t_err_evidence: I'll use Python's urllib.request to download the esci-data repository as a tarball
t_surface_evidence: Could not open Parquet input source '<Buffer>': Parquet magic bytes not found in footer.
trigger_explanation: The GitHub archive served Git LFS pointer files (133 bytes) instead of actual parquet data; the agent correctly diagnosed data corruption but then chose to fabricate dummy data rather than finding an alternative download path (e.g., huggingface datasets hub), permanently violating the task requirement of 93,347 rows.
